However, at least two concrete implementations still define `createEvent(event: CalendarEvent)` with only one parameter (e.g., `packages/app-store/larkcalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` and `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`). Since those classes `implements Calendar`, this is an interface mismatch that will break type-checking/compilation (or, if types are bypassed, will receive an extra argument unexpectedly). The finding’s “no test verifies…” framing isn’t directly provable from the diff, but the underlying issue (other implementations not updated for the new arg) is verifiable and a real defect.
